title: Punjabi Chole
subtitle: Spicy, deeply flavoured chickpea curry — stovetop or Instant Pot — for rice, poori, naan or bhatura.
protein: ~10–12g protein per adult serving — from chickpeas

nightPrep.label: Night Before
items: Rinse {@chickpeas} in plenty of water
Soak in plenty of fresh water overnight, at least 8 hours

items.name: Tea bag or 2 dried amla, optional

method.title: Pressure cook the chickpeas
items: Drain {@chickpeas|the soaked chickpeas} and rinse them well
Add them to a pressure cooker with {@water:cook} and {@tea-bag} — the tea gives chole its dark colour
Pressure cook 5–6 whistles on medium heat (Instant Pot: high pressure 35 min, natural release) — chole must be soft, not al dente
If they're still firm, cook 2 more whistles; discard the tea bag and keep the stock

method.title: Build the tomato base
items: Heat {@oil} in a pan; add {@cinnamon}, {@cloves}, {@cardamom} and {@bay-leaf}
When they begin to crackle, add {@hing} and {@ginger-paste}; sauté until the raw smell goes
Add {@celery}; sauté 3–4 min until soft
Add {@tomatoes}, {@turmeric} and {@salt}; cook until mushy and soft
Stir in {@coriander-powder}; fry 1 min

method.label: Toddler — pull her portion here (before chili and chole masala)
items: Spoon {=2 tbsp} of the tomato base into a small pan
Add {=¼ cup} of the cooked chickpeas with a little stock, and {@potato:toddler}
Simmer 3–4 min, then mash the chickpeas well — whole chickpeas are a choking risk at 2

method.title: Spice and simmer
items: Add {@green-chili:base}, {@kashmiri-chili}, {@chole-masala} and {@garam-masala} to the adult pan
Stir and fry 1–2 min until the masala smells good and the oil separates
Add the rest of the cooked chole and their stock {from Step 1}, with {@water:simmer}
Mash a few chickpeas against the pan — it thickens the gravy
Cover and simmer on low 18–20 min, until the chole absorb the masala; loosen with a splash of water if it gets too thick
When the gravy thickens, stir in {@ghee}, {@ginger-julienne}, {@green-chili:garnish} and {@kasuri-methi}; turn off and keep covered a while
Garnish with {@coriander} and serve; keeps 4 days refrigerated

method.label: Tip
method.text: Onion → celery + hing, with a few mashed chickpeas and an extra tomato for body; ginger-garlic paste → ginger alone. Many chole masala brands aren't Jain, so check the label (or make your own). Canned chickpeas: skip the night prep and Step 1 — use 4½ cups (three 15-oz cans), rinsed, and simmer with 2 cups water. Best in the Instant Pot or a stovetop pressure cooker for the chickpeas — soft chole in under an hour — then finish on the stove.
